recovery.title: Recovery After Hospital Stay
recovery.metaTitle: Recovery After Hospital Stay | Movement Science Physiotherapy
recovery.metaDescription: Transition smoothly from hospital to home with specialist physiotherapy support. Regain independence and strength after surgery or illness.
recovery.intro: After a hospital stay, returning home can feel overwhelming. Physiotherapy is essential for overcoming 'post-hospital syndrome'—addressing muscle weakness, fatigue, and reduced confidence to help you regain your independence quickly and safely.

contentSections.heading: The Phased Recovery Process
contentSections.body: Your recovery follows a structured path. In the early phase (days to 1 week), we focus on pain management and gentle movement. During the healing phase (2-4 weeks), we introduce outpatient techniques to decrease stiffness. The movement phase (4-12 weeks) ramps up activity, leading to the intensive strengthening phase (12+ weeks) to restore full power.

contentSections.heading: Personalised Home Assessment
contentSections.body: Our physiotherapists perform an initial assessment in your home to evaluate your strength, balance, and walking ability. We also assess your home environment for fall risks and collaborate with you to set achievable recovery goals, ensuring your path to normality is clear and supported.

contentSections.heading: Nutrition, Hydration, and Rest
contentSections.body: Healing requires more than just movement. A balanced diet rich in essential nutrients and proper hydration (8+ glasses of water) are vital for fighting swelling and replenishing energy. Coupled with 7-9 hours of quality sleep, these factors form the bedrock of your body's repair process.

jointpain.title: Joint and Muscular Pain
jointpain.metaTitle: Expert Joint and Muscular Pain Treatment | Movement Science
jointpain.metaDescription: Effective management and treatment for back, neck, and joint pain. Personalised physiotherapy plans to help you live pain-free.
jointpain.intro: Joint and muscular pain can stem from arthritis, acute injuries, or mechanical stress. Our expert physiotherapy treats the root cause, combining manual therapy with evidence-based exercises to restore comfort and mobility.

contentSections.heading: Understanding the Root Cause
contentSections.body: Joint pain is often linked to osteoarthritis, bursitis, or repetitive mechanical stress, while muscular pain may arise from tension, strains, or underlying inflammatory conditions. We provide a detailed diagnosis to differentiate between acute trauma and chronic wear-and-tear.

contentSections.heading: Specialised Manual Therapy
contentSections.body: We utilise advanced hands-on techniques including Soft Tissue Mobilisation (STM), Myofascial Release, and Trigger Point Therapy to release deep-seated tension. Joint mobilisation and 'Muscle Energy Techniques' (METs) are also used to lengthen shortened muscles and normalise joint mechanics.

contentSections.heading: Lifestyle and Ergonomic Strategy
contentSections.body: Recovery doesn't stop at the clinic. We provide guidance on body mechanics and posture to prevent re-injury. Whether it's adjusting your workspace or modifying your daily activities, we ensure your environment supports a pain-free life.

balance.title: Balance and Mobility
balance.metaTitle: Improve Balance and Mobility | Movement Science Physiotherapy
balance.metaDescription: Specialist physiotherapy to improve balance, prevent falls, and increase mobility in your daily life.
balance.intro: As we age, maintaining stability becomes vital for independence. Our balance and mobility programmes focus on neuro-recalibration and physical strengthening to keep you upright and confident in every step.

contentSections.heading: Balance-Enhancing Techniques
contentSections.body: Our therapy includes proven exercises like Tandem Walking (heel-to-toe), Single-Leg Stands, and Weight Shifts. These techniques retrain your body's weight distribution and proprioception—your sense of where your limbs are in space—to significantly reduce fall risks.

contentSections.heading: Building Core and Lower Body Strength
contentSections.body: Mobility is powered by strength. We incorporate chair squats, wall push-ups, and heel raises to fortify your 'foundation' muscles. These exercises are designed to be performed safely at home, gradually building the power needed for daily tasks like standing from a chair.

contentSections.heading: Tai Chi and Aerobic Health
contentSections.body: Beyond traditional exercises, we recommend gentle movements like Tai Chi for graceful, controlled stability. Brisk walking and swimming also help improve overall endurance and circulation, which indirectly support better balance.

muscularweak.title: Muscular Weakness
muscularweak.metaTitle: Treatment for Muscular Weakness | Movement Science
muscularweak.metaDescription: Regain your strength and vitality. We provide specialist physiotherapy for muscle weakness and atrophy.
muscularweak.intro: Muscular weakness can result from aging (Sarcopenia), inactivity, or chronic illness. Our core mission is to help you reverse muscle atrophy through progressive, science-based strengthening programmes.

contentSections.heading: Progressive Resistance Training (PRT)
contentSections.body: PRT is the gold standard for rebuilding muscle. We use the 'overload principle'—gradually increasing weight, resistance, or intensity—to challenge your muscles as they get stronger. Our programmes follow clinical guidelines (8-12 repetitions over 1-3 sets) to ensure optimal growth without overstrain.

contentSections.heading: Identifying Internal Causes
contentSections.body: Muscle weakness isn't always just about 'size.' It can be linked to neurological issues like pinched nerves, nutritional deficiencies, or even medication side effects. We look beyond the surface to ensure your treatment plan addresses the true driver of your weakness.

contentSections.heading: Functional Strength for Life
contentSections.body: We don't just build muscle for the sake of it; we focus on functional strength. Our exercises mimic real-life movements, such as the power needed to climb stairs, carry groceries, or push open heavy doors, ensuring your gains translate to a better life.

sports.title: Sports Injuries
sports.metaDescription: Get back in the game faster. Specialist sports injury rehabilitation for athletes of all levels.
sports.intro: From elite athletes to weekend warriors, sports injuries require a specialized approach. We implement structured, evidence-based rehabilitation to return you to peak performance while minimizing re-injury risk.

contentSections.heading: The 5-Stage Rehab Model
contentSections.body: Our sports rehab follows a strict progression: 1. Acute Phase (Pain/Inflammation Management using POLICE protocol), 2. Mobility Phase (Restoring full range of motion), 3. Strengthening Phase (Remodeling tissue), 4. Coordination Phase (Functional restoration), and 5. Return-to-Sport Phase (Sport-specific agility and drills).

contentSections.heading: Advanced Therapeutic Modalities
contentSections.body: We go beyond basic exercises, utilising advanced modalities like Cryotherapy (to reduce swelling), Electrical Stimulation (NMES) for muscle activation, and Proprioceptive Training (using balance boards) to ensure your joints remain stable under high-impact conditions.

contentSections.heading: Performance Enhancement
contentSections.body: Our goal isn't just to fix the injury; it's to make you a better athlete. We include biomechanical analysis to identify gait or movement flaws and create custom strength and conditioning programmes that build resilience against future setbacks.

falls.title: Falls and Accidents
falls.metaTitle: Falls Prevention & Accident Recovery | Movement Science
falls.metaDescription: Specialist support after a fall or accident. Improve your balance and rebuild your confidence.
falls.intro: A fall is more than just a physical event; it's a major psychological hurdle. Our expert-led recovery programmes address the trauma of falls and accidents, focusing on building physical resilience and mental confidence.

contentSections.heading: Breaking the 'Fear of Falling' Cycle
contentSections.body: The fear of falling again often leads to reduced activity, which in turn causes muscle weakness and further increases fall risk. We break this cycle through gradual exposure to movement and confidence-building exercises in the safety of your own environment.

contentSections.heading: Identifying Mechanical Triggers
contentSections.body: We look at why the fall happened. Was it a vestibular (inner ear) issue, poor lighting, or a specific muscular imbalance? By identifying the root cause, we can provide targeted interventions—such as balance recalibration or home modification advice—to prevent future incidents.

contentSections.heading: Safety and Reaction Training
contentSections.body: Falling is sometimes unavoidable, but injury doesn't have to be. We train patients in 'safe landing' techniques and reactive balance drills that improve your ability to quickly catch yourself if you trip, significantly lowering the risk of fractures.

confidence.title: Building Up Your Confidence
confidence.metaTitle: Build Confidence in Your Movement | Movement Science
confidence.metaDescription: Rebuild your physical and mental confidence after injury or illness. Specialist support to help you move freely.
confidence.intro: Physical recovery and mental confidence are two sides of the same coin. We believe that true healing happens when you feel safe, capable, and empowered to move through the world on your own terms.

contentSections.heading: The Mental Side of Mobility
contentSections.body: Long-term pain or injury can create 'learned non-use' and a deep-seated hesitation to move. Our physiotherapists use encouraging, goal-oriented therapy to help you rediscover your body's capabilities, celebrating small wins that lead to big milestones.

contentSections.heading: Empowered Independence
contentSections.body: Confidence grows from competence. We provide you with the tools and techniques to manage your condition independently. When you understand how to move safely and efficiently, the world feels smaller and more accessible.

contentSections.heading: A Supportive Environment
contentSections.body: We create a high-trust partnership between therapist and patient. By listening to your concerns and moving at a pace that feels right for you, we ensure that every session builds not just strength, but the self-belief needed for long-term health.

swelljoints.title: Swollen Joints
swelljoints.metaTitle: Treatment for Swollen & Painful Joints | Movement Science
swelljoints.metaDescription: Relieve joint swelling and inflammation. Specialist physiotherapy for arthritis and acute joint issues.
swelljoints.intro: Inflammation is the body's natural response to injury or arthritis, but when it becomes chronic, it limits life. We use advanced clinical modalities to reduce joint swelling and restore smooth, pain-free movement.

contentSections.heading: Advanced Clinical Modalities
contentSections.body: To target deep inflammation, we utilise therapeutic technologies such as Ultrasound (which increases circulation) and TENS (for non-invasive pain relief). These are combined with Iontophoresis to help deliver anti-inflammatory benefits directly to the affected tissues.

contentSections.heading: The Power of Hydrotherapy
contentSections.body: Water-based therapy is incredibly effective for swollen joints. The buoyancy of water reduces the load on your joints by up to 90%, allowing you to perform strengthening exercises that would be too painful on land, while the water pressure naturally helps reduce swelling (oedema).

contentSections.heading: Arthritis Management
contentSections.body: For those with rheumatoid or osteoarthritis, we provide long-term joint protection strategies. This includes education on pacing your activities, using ergonomic aids, and performing gentle range-of-motion exercises that keep joints lubricated without causing flare-ups.

working.title: Returning To Work
working.metaTitle: Occupational Health & Return to Work | Movement Science
working.metaDescription: Expert support to help you safely and effectively return to work after injury or illness.
working.intro: Your job's demands are unique. Our 'Return to Work' programmes are job-specific, focusing on the ergonomics, stamina, and functional strength you need to excel in your professional environment without risking re-injury.

contentSections.heading: Ergonomic Optimisation
contentSections.body: Whether you sit at a desk or operate heavy machinery, your posture matters. We provide custom ergonomic assessments to ensure your workspace is set up to support your musculoskeletal health, reducing the risk of repetitive strain and chronic fatigue.

contentSections.heading: Work-Ready Functional Training
contentSections.body: We simulate real-world job tasks in a controlled environment. By practicing lifting, reaching, or sustained sitting under the guidance of a physiotherapist, you build the specific endurance required for your 9-to-5, ensuring a sustainable and successful return.

contentSections.heading: Phased Re-Integration
contentSections.body: A successful return to work is often gradual. We advise on light duties and modified schedules, serving as a bridge between your recovery and full professional capacity. We work with you to communicate these needs effectively to your employer.

outdoors.title: Mobility Outdoors
outdoors.metaTitle: Outdoor Mobility & confidence training | Movement Science
outdoors.metaDescription: Master uneven terrain and outdoor environments. We help you regain the confidence to enjoy the outdoors safely.
outdoors.intro: The world outside isn't a flat clinic floor. Our outdoor mobility training prepares you for the unpredictability of real-world terrain—from steep curbs and uneven pavements to grassy slopes and busy shopping centres.

contentSections.heading: Navigating Uneven Terrain
contentSections.body: We practice techniques for safely managing 'real-world' challenges. This includes proper foot placement on slopes, strategies for crossing busy roads, and building the ankle stability needed for gravel paths or grassy parks.

contentSections.heading: Adaptive Outdoor Solutions
contentSections.body: For those with more complex needs, we provide guidance on specialized outdoor mobility aids—such as all-terrain walkers or ergonomic canes. We ensure your equipment is perfectly fitted for the specific environments you want to revisit.

contentSections.heading: Community Access Training
contentSections.body: Regaining your outdoor mobility is about more than just walking; it's about reconnecting with your community. Our sessions can involve visits to your local shops or favorite parks, building the confidence you need to enjoy life beyond your front door.

mobilediff.title: Mobility Difficulties At Home
mobilediff.metaTitle: Improve Home Mobility | Movement Science Physiotherapy
mobilediff.metaDescription: Specialist support for mobility issues at home. We help you navigate your living space safely and independently.
mobilediff.intro: Your home should be your sanctuary, not a series of obstacles. We specialize in helping you master the specific challenges of your living space, ensuring you can move between rooms, levels, and amenities with ease.

contentSections.heading: Home Safety Modifications
contentSections.body: We conduct a thorough 'Hazard Audit' of your home, advising on essential modifications like grab bars in bathrooms, handrail placement on stairs, and identifying trip hazards like loose rugs or poor lighting that could lead to accidents.

contentSections.heading: Specialised Transfer Training
contentSections.body: Independence starts with basic movements. We train you in the safest, most efficient ways to transfer—getting in and out of bed, on and off the toilet, and safely using the shower—using specialized techniques that minimize strain on your joints.

contentSections.heading: Adapting Your Living Space
contentSections.body: We help you re-organize your environment to find 'the path of least resistance.' By placing frequently used items within easy reach and optimizing your furniture layout, we help you conserve energy and maximize your daily independence.
